annotations.title: Look at a photo or video

description: Look at one stored picture of this workspace: the answer is the picture itself. Use it on every picture templates_render made, before showing it to the user: check that no line is cut off, that the words fit their space and that the photo sits well, and render again if not. A video answers with its still picture. Changes nothing.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

id.description: A media id from media_upload or media_list.
